dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

label.description: A label to be shown above the input.

hintText.description: Descriptive text to aid the user in interacting with this input.

updateOnDataHandleWithContextVar.description:
Whether or not to update the field value when it loads its data if the inputElement utilizes contextVars.
Current behavior for updating is to clear the field's value. The recommendation is to always keep it on true, unless
you are setting a {@link UiSdlFieldSettingBase#dataPropSpecs} on the field that reads data that has been set via {@link UiSdlConnected#derivedProps}.

inputElement.description: The input element for this field set input field.

metricBasedComponentsToInputMapping.description:
Each {@link UiSdlFieldSetInputFieldSetting} can filter multiple components on a page
 and each page can have multiple components that are expected to respond to a filter panel.
 This is a mapping that binds:
  types and their metric expression, that back the other components on a page
    ->
  this instance of {@link UiSdlFieldSetInputFieldSetting}.
 Input/Expression field is only used to filter at metric expression.
 All components that show up in the grid must have dataspec that extends {@link UiSdlMetricBasedDataSpec}
 @example
 ```json
 {
   "MyApp.MyTimeSeriesChartComponent": { "TestMetricEvaluatable ": "expression" },
   "MyApp.MyMetricTileComponent": { "TestMetricEvaluatable": "expression" },
 }
```
